reason: A persistent memory and context plugin for DeepSeek Harness that manages user and project memory files, exposes memory tools and search, injects selected memories into requests, and optionally performs LLM-based learning and consolidation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话的用户、项目和失败记忆存储、检索及请求上下文注入，并配有记忆管理界面。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent user, project, and failure memory storage, search, request-context injection, and a memory management interface.

capabilities: Stores persistent user, project, preference, and failure memories in local files
Reads, adds, updates, deletes, and rewrites memory entries through plugin tools
Injects selected memory and standing-instruction content into request context
Searches memory using optional SQLite full-text and vector indexes
Uses session LLM calls for optional background learning and memory consolidation
Provides a WebUI page for memory and plugin configuration management
Can optionally access remote embedding APIs or download local embedding models
